documents.title: Faculty Guide: AI and ChatGPT: Academic Integrity
documents.quality_note: Library faculty guide; the page opens with MLA/APA citation help, then a 'Syllabus Statement: Guidelines' section (when AI is permitted/forbidden) with links to three example statements. Not an official provost policy; no official university-wide AI policy found.

notes: ACU provost academic-integrity pages (acu.edu/office-of-the-provost/rights-and-responsibilities-academic-integrity/, acu.edu/?p=55838) were fetched and contain no AI text, so not collected. Trinka's repository claims a university rule (AI prohibited unless instructor permits), but it is a third-party summary and its source was not found. Not collected: Adams Center 'AI Syllabus Statement' (a single CHEM 430 course statement; course layer deferred); libguide 'Assignments' page (pedagogy tips, no rules). No CS department AI policy found. The libguide's example-statement sub-pages were not fetched individually.
